svg.metadata: Target Morocco geometry and Western Sahara surrounding context: Natural Earth 1:10m cultural vectors, WGS84, public domain. Morocco target geometry uses the MAR source north of the Natural Earth Western Saharan claim line. The visible Western Sahara land context is derived from the same verified MAR coastline/boundary geometry south of the Natural Earth ne_10m_admin_0_boundary_lines_disputed_areas feature (FEATURECLA=Elusive frontier, NAME=Western Saharan claim), and is rendered in the surrounding-land style rather than target fill. Administrative depiction does not assert a position on disputed sovereignty. Bounds W -17.8 S 25.4 E -0.5 N 36.8.

path.aria-label: Western Sahara eastern and southern borders
